To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a novel approach to customer experience optimization by integrating user experience modeling and user interface adaptation.
the SitAdapt system is able to adapt a user interface to the user's situation and thereby optimize the customer experience.

we have developed a system, called SitAdapt 1.0, that can adapt user interfaces to the user's current situation, which can be determined by a combination of eye tracking and situation rules, and that we have extended this system to SitAdapt 3.0 by adding emotion recognition and by using the system in an e commerce scenario.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (1) Situation based customer experience optimization for e business platforms (2) Dynamic adaptation of the user interface (3) Rapid generation of user interface adaptations based on HCI patterns (4) Situation analytics and situation rules for the detection of user situations (5) Situation based emotion recognition (6) Eye tracking based situation detection.

the following questions: 1. How can the customer experience in digital marketing be optimized for individual users? 2. How can user interface adaptation be used to optimize the customer experience? 3. How can the user interface adaptation process be supported? 4. How can the adaptation process be evaluated?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SitAdapt 3.0 is an effective system for the optimization of customer experience.
the system SitAdapt 3.0 is a very good and useful tool, but the system has to be improved in several areas, especially in the areas of emotion recognition and the usability of the system.
SitAdapt 1.0 and 2.0 are able to support user experience and customer experience in e commerce scenarios.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SitAdapt system provides a flexible and powerful approach for user interface adaptation in e commerce.
we developed an approach to model the user experience in a customer journey and to use this model for customer experience optimization in an e business scenario.
we have developed and evaluated the SitAdapt system that enables user interface adaptation based on the continuous recognition of user situations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to model and implement a system for customer experience optimization that can be applied to different scenarios and domains.
the combination of situation based adaptation and user interface modeling is a viable approach to improve user experience.
the user interface can dynamically adapt in order to optimize the user experience and guide users through their tasks.
